description: Land Acquisition - Kadigava, Polonthalawa, Rasnayakapura D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Tellipalai West, Valikamam North D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including precise descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes or structural modifications beyond the ministerial authorization required for land acquisition proceedings.
